typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{[Unit Number]} as string,
		{[Facility ID]} as string,
		{[Complex ID]} as string,
		{[Yard ID]} as string,
		{[Carrier Visit Key]} as long,
		{[Carrier Service]} as string,
		{[Event Type ID]} as string,
		{[Move Kind]} as string,
		{[From Location]} as string,
		{[To Location]} as string,
		{[From Position Name]} as string,
		{[To Position Name]} as string,
		{[QC CHE ID]} as short,
		{[QC CHE Kind]} as string,
		{[Unit POD]} as string,
		{[Carry Complete Time]} as string,
		{[Put Time]} as string,
		{[Fetch Time]} as string,
		{[Dispatch Time]} as string,
		{[Carry Dispatch Time]} as string,
		{[Carry Fetch Ready Time]} as string,
		{[Carry Put Ready Time]} as string,
		{[Twin Fetch]} as string,
		{[Twin Carry]} as string,
		{[Twin Put]} as string,
		{[Category ID]} as string,
		{[Freight Kind ID]} as string,
		{[Container Line ID]} as string,
		{[Container Line Role]} as string,
		{[POW]} as string,
		{[Berth ID]} as string,
		{[Requires Power Flag]} as string,
		{[OOG Flag]} as string,
		{[ATA]} as string,
		{[Carry Distance]} as integer,
		{[Start Distance]} as integer,
		{[From Position Gkey]} as long,
		{[Move Gkey]} as long,
		{[UFV Gkey]} as long,
		{[Goods and Container Weight Kg]} as string,
		{[Active UFV]} as long,
		{[Rehandles]} as string,
		{[Shipper ID]} as string,
		{[Commodity ID]} as integer,
		{[Consignee ID]} as string,
		{[Put CHE ID]} as short,
		{[Put CHE Operator ID]} as string,
		{[Put CHE Kind]} as string,
		{[Carry CHE ID]} as integer,
		{[Carry CHE Operator ID]} as string,
		{[Carry CHE Kind]} as string,
		{[To Position Gkey]} as long,
		{[Restow Reason]} as string,
		{[Discharge Time]} as string,
		{[Fetch CHE ID]} as integer,
		{[Fetch CHE Operator ID]} as short,
		{[Fetch CHE Kind]} as string,
		{[ATD]} as string
	),
	useSchema: false,
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	moveFiles: ['/bronze/moves/load','/bronze/moves/archive'],
	format: 'delimited',
	fileSystem: 'apmt-elz',
	folderPath: 'bronze/moves/load',
	columnDelimiter: ',',
	escapeChar: '\\',
	quoteChar: '\"',
	columnNamesAsHeader: true,
	dateFormats: ['dd-MM-yyyy'],
	timestampFormats: ['yyyy-MM-dd\'T\'HH:mm:ss.SSS\'Z\'','yyyy-MM-dd\'T\'HH:mm:ss\'Z\'']) ~> CSV
Aggregate1 derive(t_carry_complete = coalesce(toTimestamp({[Carry_Complete_Time]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Complete_Time]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Complete_Time]},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Complete_Time]},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Complete_Time]},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({[Carry_Complete_Time]},'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Complete_Time]},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		t_discharge = coalesce(toTimestamp({[Discharge_Time]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({[Discharge_Time]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Discharge_Time]},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({[Discharge_Time]},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Discharge_Time]},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Discharge_Time]},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({[Discharge_Time]},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Discharge_Time]},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		Fetch_CHE_Id = toLong({[Fetch_CHE_ID]}),
		QC_CHE_Id = toLong({[QC_CHE_ID]}),
		Put_CHE_Id = toLong({[Put_CHE_ID]}),
		Carry_CHE_Id = toLong({[Carry_CHE_ID]}),
		Year = year(t_put),
		Month = month(t_put),
		Week = weekOfYear(t_put),
		t_dispatch = coalesce(toTimestamp({[Dispatch_Time]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({[Dispatch_Time]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Dispatch_Time]},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({[Dispatch_Time]},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Dispatch_Time]},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Dispatch_Time]},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({[Dispatch_Time]},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Dispatch_Time]},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		t_carry_dispatch = coalesce(toTimestamp({[Carry_Dispatch_Time]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Dispatch_Time]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Dispatch_Time]},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Dispatch_Time]},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Dispatch_Time]},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Dispatch_Time]},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({[Carry_Dispatch_Time]},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Dispatch_Time]},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		t_carry_fetch_ready = coalesce(toTimestamp({[Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time]},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time]},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time]},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time]},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({[Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time]},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time]},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		t_carry_put_ready = coalesce(toTimestamp({[Carry_Put_Ready_Time]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Put_Ready_Time]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Put_Ready_Time]},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Put_Ready_Time]},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Put_Ready_Time]},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Put_Ready_Time]},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({[Carry_Put_Ready_Time]},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Carry_Put_Ready_Time]},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		ATD = coalesce(toTimestamp({[ATD]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({[ATD]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[ATD]},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({[ATD]},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[ATD]},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[ATD]},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({[ATD]},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[ATD]},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		ATA = coalesce(toTimestamp({[ATA]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({[ATA]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[ATA]},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({[ATA]},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[ATA]},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[ATA]},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({[ATA]},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[ATA]},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		mve_gkey = toLong(mve_gkey),
		Carrier_Visit_Key = toLong({[Carrier_Visit_Key]})) ~> DataTypeConversion
Select2 select(mapColumn(
		each(match(true()),
			regexReplace($$,' ','_') = $$)
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
Select1 aggregate(groupBy(mve_gkey),
	each(match(name!='mve_gkey'), $$ = first($$))) ~> Aggregate1
derivedColumn1 select(mapColumn(
		each(match(/* All input columns */true()),
			/* Input name */$$ = $$)
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
select3 alterRow(upsertIf(true())) ~> AlterRow1
CSV derive({[Carrier Visit Key]} = toLong({[Carrier Visit Key]}),
		mve_gkey = toLong({[Move Gkey]}),
		t_put = coalesce(toTimestamp({[Put Time]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({[Put Time]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Put Time]},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({[Put Time]},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Put Time]},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Put Time]},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({[Put Time]},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Put Time]},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		t_fetch = coalesce(toTimestamp({[Fetch Time]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({[Fetch Time]},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Fetch Time]},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({[Fetch Time]},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Fetch Time]},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Fetch Time]},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({[Fetch Time]},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({[Fetch Time]},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		ufv_gkey = toLong({[UFV Gkey]})) ~> derivedColumn1
DataTypeConversion select(mapColumn(
		mve_gkey,
		Unit_Nbr = {[Unit_Number]},
		Facility_Id = {[Facility_ID]},
		Yard_Id = {[Yard_ID]},
		Carrier_Visit_Key,
		Event_Type_Id = {[Event_Type_ID]},
		Move_Kind = {[Move_Kind]},
		From_Location = {[From_Location]},
		To_Location = {[To_Location]},
		From_Position_Name = {[From_Position_Name]},
		To_Position_Name = {[To_Position_Name]},
		Carry_CHE_Operator_Id = {[Carry_CHE_Operator_ID]},
		Fetch_CHE_Operator_Id = {[Fetch_CHE_Operator_ID]},
		Put_CHE_Operator_Id = {[Put_CHE_Operator_ID]},
		Fetch_CHE_Id,
		Fetch_CHE_Kind = {[Fetch_CHE_Kind]},
		Carry_CHE_Id,
		Carry_CHE_Kind = {[Carry_CHE_Kind]},
		Put_CHE_Id,
		Put_CHE_Kind = {[Put_CHE_Kind]},
		QC_CHE_Id,
		QC_CHE_Kind = {[QC_CHE_Kind]},
		t_carry_complete,
		t_put,
		t_fetch,
		t_dispatch,
		t_discharge,
		t_carry_dispatch,
		t_carry_fetch_ready,
		t_carry_put_ready,
		dist_carry = {[Carry_Distance]},
		dist_start = {[Start_Distance]},
		Twin_Fetch = {[Twin_Fetch]},
		Twin_Carry = {[Twin_Carry]},
		Twin_Put = {[Twin_Put]},
		Category_Id = {[Category_ID]},
		Freight_Kind_Id = {[Freight_Kind_ID]},
		Restow_Reason = {[Restow_Reason]},
		POW = {[POW]},
		ufv_gkey,
		Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg = {[Goods_and_Container_Weight_Kg]},
		Requires_Power_Flag = {[Requires_Power_Flag]},
		OOG_Flag = {[OOG_Flag]},
		ATA,
		ATD,
		Rehandles = {[Rehandles]},
		Year,
		Month,
		Week,
		POD = {[Unit_POD]}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> select3
AlterRow1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	format: 'delta',
	fileSystem: 'apmt-elz',
	folderPath: 'silver/moves',
	mergeSchema: true,
	autoCompact: false,
	optimizedWrite: false,
	vacuum: 0,
	deletable: false,
	insertable: false,
	updateable: false,
	upsertable: true,
	keys:['mve_gkey'],
	umask: 0777,
	preCommands: [],
	postCommands: [],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		mve_gkey,
		Unit_Nbr,
		Facility_Id,
		Yard_Id,
		Carrier_Visit_Key,
		Event_Type_Id,
		Move_Kind,
		From_Location,
		To_Location,
		From_Position_Name,
		To_Position_Name,
		Carry_CHE_Operator_Id,
		Fetch_CHE_Operator_Id,
		Put_CHE_Operator_Id,
		Fetch_CHE_Id,
		Fetch_CHE_Kind,
		Carry_CHE_Id,
		Carry_CHE_Kind,
		Put_CHE_Id,
		Put_CHE_Kind,
		QC_CHE_Id,
		QC_CHE_Kind,
		t_carry_complete,
		t_put,
		t_fetch,
		t_dispatch,
		t_discharge,
		t_carry_dispatch,
		t_carry_fetch_ready,
		t_carry_put_ready,
		dist_carry,
		dist_start,
		Twin_Fetch,
		Twin_Carry,
		Twin_Put,
		Category_Id,
		Freight_Kind_Id,
		Restow_Reason,
		POW,
		ufv_gkey,
		Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg,
		Requires_Power_Flag,
		OOG_Flag,
		ATA,
		ATD,
		Rehandles,
		Year,
		Month,
		Week,
		POD
	)) ~> sink1
